world.title: The night the dead tree sang again
world.description: Ko Setlhareng.com tree is gone along with the shade, cassettes and CDs that once piled beneath its branches. The acacia tree was swallowed by the cold march of time, digital streaming and the quiet death of an analogue era. But last Friday, less than 200 metres from where Ko Setlhareng.com once stood in the Gaborone Main Mall, something strange happened and the dead seemed to sing again.
